title: Tap again while walking (retarget mid-step)
about: Owner bug 2. Farm, 09:00, the farmer at (10,17) facing east on an open row, nothing to work nearby. Tap (18,17), and while he walks tap (21,17) further on: he keeps going with no stop, no step back and no turn, the walk cycle running on; the path dots move to the new goal without a flash. Then tap (14,21), ahead and to the side: he finishes the step he is on, then turns once. Tap behind him (10,17): he turns back at once (the direction really changed). Hold a finger still mid-walk: the preview stays up until it lifts. e2e: e2e:controls, 'a second tap ahead mid-step keeps walking'.
